[EFFECT] The effect of wind speed on hourly demand is non-monotonic — it rises and falls across the range. Its shape is non-monotonic, with the contribution highest around 7.3 km/h.

[IMPORTANCE] Wind speed ranks 8 of 9 features by global importance (importance 0.014) — a minor driver of demand.

[RECOMMENDATION] Account for wind speed when planning bikes and staff: demand is highest around 7.3 km/h, so allocate more there and less at the opposite end.
